    "38db7aa3: ;Call the FileMan entry point to update the 'PT' component security key translation global.",
    "0e5f17d5: ;Initialize variables for DIC, DIE, and other FileMan utilities. The data\n ;is stored in the PROTOCOL file (#393). Also initialize arrays used to\n ;store the security key data.",

    "3b118007: ;Return to the FileMan utilities.",
    "3982293b: ;Output the current value of the 'PT' field for this protocol entry.",
    "ce86ad41: ;Call standard FileMan utilities to handle reading a new value if\n ;the data value type indicates free text or a SET OF CODES.",
    "b333f7bb: ;If the data value is INTERNAL and there is an entry in the local array,\n ;display the 'No Editing' prompt.",
    "e00c73a6: ;Read a new value for the 'PT' field. If the user times out, set the\n ;time-out variable and value to null.",
    "574fa530: Quit if invalid option is entered",
    "11d632e2: Increment the order of the Mumps Virtual Machine (DQ) pointer",
    "24a9f81c: Branch to the next line of code based on the DQ pointer",
    "08224114: Go to PR label if data exists in DE array for the current DQ, otherwise do W and TR",

    "c8d0a342: If X is '?', go to QS label, else if X starts with '^', do D subroutine and go to ^DIE17 label",
    "0b417cb3: If X is '@', do D subroutine and go to Z^DIE2 label",
    "96ba50b6: If X is ' ', DV contains 'd', DV doesn't contain 'P', and DUZ has a default value in ^DISV for the current DLB, set X to that value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' or 'S', write X preceded by '  '",
    "d970ac01: If DV is defined, go to M^DIE17 label, else if DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3 label, else if DV doesn't contain 'S', go to P label. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) exists, execute it. Set % to the piece after ';_X_:' in ';_DU' string. Set Y to X. If % is non-null and DIC('S') exists, execute DIC('S'). If DB(DQ) is undefined, write '  ' followed by %. Go to V label",
    "ae3d5ab9: ;Check for any executable code specified in the variable DIC(\"S\") and execute it.",
    "01b22d77: ;If no entry was selected, write the remaining portion of the input string and reset the variable X to prepare for the next input.",
    "fd6f3c09: ;If the data validation specifies a File entry (P), perform a lookup in that file using ^DIC. Handle different flags for whether to allow LAYGO, whether to require an exact match, etc.",
    "623995ab: ;If the data validation does not allow numeric responses (N flag), and the input is longer than 24 characters after the decimal point, reject the input by setting X to null.",
    "0d3c3114: If the device window width parameter is non-zero and the response contains a decimal point, and the special QIO parameters contain no $ protection, then perform formatting on the response value X. If the response has leading zeros, strip them. If the response has trailing non-numeric characters, remove them. If the response is just a decimal point, convert it to a numeric value.",
    "55481f43: Kill any existing ScreenMan form values and quit if the form is exited.",
    "90d0cdff: Save the user's response in the DISV file if this is a date/time field. Otherwise, quit without saving changes.",
    "f983f2f8: Display the '??' prompt if there is a 'DIEHU' Help utility and branch to the ScreenMan utility to process the help request.",
    "bea82da4: Set the response value to '?BAD' for an invalid entry.",
    "4d3d333c: Call the DIEQ routine to perform post-input transforms and branching logic based on the user's response.",
    "85a4bcfb: Load the field properties into the DQ array for use by other routines.",
    "a09823aa: If there is no data dictionary definition for this field, call the DIEFU utility. If the user entered an '@' and the field is not read-only, quit or branch accordingly. Otherwise, set the internal value to the user's response and continue.",
    "b970a768: If the field has executable code, run it and then go to the RP label.",
    "e378afb8: If the data type is a pointer and the pointed-to file exists, get the file number and if the pointed-to field exists, get the global node, computation code, and description and recursively call the R label.",
    "4df75b82: If the data type is variable pointer and the pointed-to file exists, get the file number and if the pointed-to field exists, get the global node, computation code, and description and recursively call the R label.",
    "d19eefc9: ;Extract the $P of X after Y and before the next semicolon (if present); store in Y if result is non-null.",
    "ce6e16e7: ;Read or derive value for input transform.",
    "08daefb2: ;If the data type does not allow IMPRECISE or FORCED VALUE CHECKING, use regular data input.",
    "6e837895: ;Else, perform external data transform and check for new value. Quit if error.",
    "e1a01809: ;Quit if no change made.",
    "3c17c92b: ;Initialize variables for loop.",
    "6a947cd9: ;Set up field characteristics.",
    "b750296e: ;Set up input variable pointer.",
    "a26f1bdf: ;Set initial value for transform.",
    "ba46a5f7: ;Save initial value for later.",
    "45c6d55d: ;Perform input transform and set new value if valid. Quit if error.",
    "91912a7b: ;If valid value entered, update database. Otherwise, read new value.",
    "71af18b7: ;Place to put additional ^DD code for cross-references, etc.",
    "33ec2a4f: ;Perform field input transform if defined and branch to next field."
  ]
}
